name: conversation-assignment
description: One assignment event on a conversation: which team member owns the thread now, who decided it, and when. Every row is immutable history, so the rows for one conversation ARE the audit trail: the latest row names the current owner, and reassigning writes a new row rather than rewriting one. An unassigned conversation is a row with no assignee, never a deleted row. Every field is managed: an assignment exists only through the interactions package's log capability or its assign action, and no client can create, forge or rewrite one. A member id is an opaque team string, the same shape as the team author on an outbound message: there is no roster table here and none is created.
